english.notes:
(i) Goods prohibited to be imported under the Customs Consolidation Act 1876 are indecent or obscene prints, paintings, photographs, books, cards, lithographic or other engravings, or any other indecent or obscene articles.
(ii) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions.(iv) Childlike sex dolls - whilst there is no specific offence of simply possessing a childlike sex doll there are some potential connected offences. This is one of the possible offences and CPS have provided some useful Legal Guidance which provides the details.
